logPolicy.raw: Exact connector-decoded strings encoded as UTF-8. Original HTTP archive bytes are not exposed by this connector. Original strings are retained privately in scratch; bounded redacted derivatives are separate.
logPolicy.bounded: BOM/ANSI removal, LF normalization, credential-shaped redaction, then explicit middle omission if necessary; every derivative has its own digest.
logPolicy.timestamps: Actual jobs-API step envelopes. No command process duration is synthesized.

unrecordedCommands.step: Verify installed default-off memory retention and restart
Exercise project memory and affected context browser flows

applicationCountCoverage.scope: Totals count observed summaries only. Missing summaries do not establish zero executed or failed tests.

browserCountCoverage.scope: Whole-job summary totals are retained; per-suite rows bind actual invocation ranges. No absent suite is counted as a pass.
